scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared packages/engine packages/bot services/game && npm run build --workspace @bubble/frontend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/engine packages/bot services/game --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspace @bubble/frontend
scripts.dev: tsc -b packages/shared packages/engine && npm run dev --workspace @bubble/frontend
scripts.server: tsc -b packages/shared packages/engine packages/bot services/game && node services/game/dist/index.js
